title: Example Feedback Taxonomy {{new.label}}
subtitle: Synthetic example for the support and product teams that tag customer feedback

overview.alt: Version {{old.label}} has {{counts.before}} records and version {{new.label}} has {{counts.after}}. FB-007 Wrong invoice address is merged into FB-006 Invoice error. FB-019 Fax support request is removed with no successor. FB-023 Refund delay, FB-024 Damaged packaging, and FB-025 Two-factor code not received are added. FB-013 moves from Delivery to Product and FB-020 from Support to Account. Category totals go from {{groups.Product.before}} to {{groups.Product.after}} in Product, {{groups.Support.before}} to {{groups.Support.after}} in Support, and {{groups.Account.before}} to {{groups.Account.after}} in Account; Billing and Delivery keep theirs.

summary: A record is one tag that agents attach to customer feedback; each record belongs to one category.
**FB-007 Wrong invoice address** is merged into **FB-006 Invoice error**.
**FB-019 Fax support request** is removed and has no successor.

items: **FB-025 Two-factor code not received** in Account
FB-011 Late delivery now uses the latest date shown at checkout
FB-014 Defective product covers the warranty period only
FB-016 Sign-in failure covers correct credentials only

summary: Category totals change for Account, Product, and Support.

items: Use FB-023, FB-024, and FB-025 for the three new cases
Check the latest delivery date at checkout before tagging FB-011

actions.what: re-tag stored FB-007 feedback as FB-006.
items: Re-tag stored FB-016 feedback about a missing sign-in code as FB-025
Keep stored FB-019 tags as history; the fax line is closed
FB-014 now counts only defects within the warranty period

actions.what: handle FB-025 tickets, which the queue now routes to you.

figures.title: Records by kind of change
figures.caption: A new definition is the most common change, with {{field_changes.definition.major}} records.

figures.title: Records per category
figures.caption: Account goes from {{groups.Account.before}} to {{groups.Account.after}}: FB-020 moved in and FB-025 was added. Support goes from {{groups.Support.before}} to {{groups.Support.after}}: FB-020 moved out and FB-019 was removed. Product goes from {{groups.Product.before}} to {{groups.Product.after}}: FB-013 moved in. Delivery stays at {{groups.Delivery.after}}: FB-013 moved out and FB-024 was added. Billing stays at {{groups.Billing.after}}: FB-007 was merged and FB-023 was added.

changes.title: Wrong invoice address merged into FB-006 Invoice error
changes.why: Agents could not choose between the two records when an invoice had both a wrong address and a wrong amount.
impact: New feedback goes to FB-006, whose definition now names the billing address
FB-006 is handled sooner in the queue than FB-007 was; lower priority numbers come first

changes.title: Slow shipping renamed Late delivery, with a date-based definition
why: The old definition depended on what the customer expected
The new one compares the arrival with the latest date shown at checkout, so two agents tag the same parcel the same way
Late deliveries now get the same refund and priority as **FB-008 Lost parcel**
changes.impact: Agents check the checkout date before tagging; late deliveries join the most urgent priority level.

figure.title: Records with a new priority
figure.caption: FB-002, FB-011, and FB-017 each move one level toward the front of the queue. Lower numbers are handled first.

changes.title: Defective product limited to the warranty period
changes.why: Complaints about products used against their instructions were tagged here, so the reported defect rate was too high.
impact: Expect fewer FB-014 tags from the release date on
Product teams mark that date on their defect-rate charts

changes.to_be: cannot sign in to their account with correct credentials.
changes.title: Login problem renamed Sign-in failure and limited to correct credentials
why: Missing two-factor codes now have their own record, FB-025
The new name matches the wording on the sign-in page
changes.impact: Agents tag a missing code as FB-025; report owners re-tag stored two-factor feedback.

figure.title: Stored feedback per record, before and after re-tagging
figure.caption: Re-tagging moves {{facts.stored_fb007_before}} stored FB-007 tags to FB-006 and {{facts.stored_fb025_after}} FB-016 tags to FB-025.

changes.title: Two-factor code not received added
changes.why: Agents tagged missing two-factor codes as FB-016, but a different team fixes them.
changes.impact: The queue routes FB-025 to the identity team.

reasons.FB-004: Only card payments can be declined at checkout
reasons.FB-009: Wrong size or color was tagged inconsistently
reasons.FB-020: The account team handles data requests
reasons.FB-023: Refund delays were tagged as invoice errors
reasons.FB-024: Packaging damage was tagged as lost or wrong items

sections.heading: Compatibility of feedback exports
items: CSV exports of tagged feedback keep the same columns
Every record keeps its ID except FB-007 and FB-019, which no longer exist
